description: Dispatch-point routing witness: seals the routing decision, the candidate set as presented, the selected target and the stated reason at the moment of dispatch, and mints a verdict against the operator's own stated routing policy (AS-DECLARED / DEVIATION / CANDIDATE-SET-ABSENT / UNVERIFIABLE), recomputable by any holder of the sealed record. Hash-only custody; dispatch record only.
name: ai.cetech/eclipse-routeseal

environmentVariables.description: Path to the operator's stated routing policies JSON.
environmentVariables.name: ECLIPSE_ROUTESEAL_POLICIES

environmentVariables.description: Path to the dispatch-point adapter keys JSON (operator-held in production).
environmentVariables.name: ECLIPSE_ROUTESEAL_ADAPTER_KEYS

title: Cyan Eclipse Routeseal
